_comment: Two identical Spearmen lines face an identical cavalry charge. The right line (uid 1) is ordered to Brace early and settles well before contact; the left line (uid 0) is left at the no-order default, which holds formation rather than auto-advancing. Both lines therefore wait in place. The left-hand cavalry spawns 30 wu closer (y=770 vs 800) so its charge lands inside the 240-frame / 480-tick window -- with equal spawn depth the left pair only meets around tick 520, past the cutoff this clip keeps so a charging regiment does not outrun its own contact resistance and punch through the braced line. Demonstrates the graded soldier_brace() formula: on impact the unbraced line is shoved forward into the melee (its own rear is -y), while the braced line holds near where it stood. World coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
